text:
Maya Rao: Heads up — design question. If a routing policy downgrades a tenant from Dedicated to Hosted during capacity pressure, what should the console show for that tenant's role-scoped quotas? Do we show the original reserved quota, the routed (current) quota, or an 'effective' merged value? :thinking:
Ruben Li: I'd prefer showing an explicit 'effective quota' computed from routing + role rules. Users get confused when the UI shows a number that doesn't match what actually applies at runtime.
Priya Shah: Agreed on effective, but we should also surface the rule sources. e.g., show: Original quota (reserved): 10 rps, Routing override: 2 rps, Effective: 2 rps. Small footprint in the table.
Sam Ortiz: Important: this affects billing and telemetry. If we only show effective, customers may think we changed their contract. Need a tooltip/link to rollout/canary history.
Maya Rao: Good point. Proposal: default column shows Effective; hover opens compact modal with bullets for "Reserved", "Route policy", "Scope override", and a "Why am I seeing this?" help link. Also a small badge when routing is active: (routed).
Ruben Li: UX nit — in multi-route setups the effective computation is non-trivial (weighted routing, region failover). Let's capture the math exactly and SDK it: /api/internal/roles/evaluate?tenant_id=.. returns {"effective_quota":..., "sources": [..]}.
Priya Shah: Can we add a sample payload in console devtools? Something like:
```json
{
  "tenant_id":"acme-123",
  "route_context":{ "region":"eu-west-1", "capacity_tier":"hosted" }
}
```
and show the returned breakdown.
Sam Ortiz: Operational ask — telemetry must log both pre- and post-routing values so billing and SLO charts show what was configured vs what was applied. Trace IDs in the UI modal will help support.
Maya Rao: UX follow-up: when a tenant is on a canary routing policy (partial fallback), show a mini sparkline of applied throughput in the quota cell and a link to the rollout page. Anyone opposed?
Ruben Li: No objections. One API caveat: the evaluator needs to be cheap (we'll compute at render time for ~50 tenants on a page). Cache results for 30s and invalidate on policy change.
Priya Shah: Telemetry schema proposal: emit event role.quota.eval with fields [tenant_id, route_id, effective_quota, sources_hash]. That lets us diff over time.
Sam Ortiz: For rollout UX, add an action button: "Simulate as this route" that calls the evaluator with simulated route_context. Useful for support.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: console/rbac/effective-quota-preview v0.1 -> staging (build 8421) :rocket:
Maya Rao: I'll iterate on the mock with those pieces (effective + sources + sparkline + simulate). Will post screenshots. Thanks all. :+1:
